MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

3. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 25

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 22
   C. 14
   D. 33

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 36
   C. 45
   D. 18

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
